content:
Once the Jan Lokpal Bill gets passed, we will stop jumping the signals, we will stop littering our roads and dirtying the rivers, we will stop procuring liquor before the official age of whatever, we will stop using ‘approach’ to get admissions in good schools (Akhir mere bete ke future ka sawaal hai!). Isn’t it ?

Yeah! After all Lokpal is the solution to all problems and once it comes, humaara desh corruption se aazaad ho jaaega ! Waah what a vision!

Courtesy – Sarah Zia
